name: Bromocriptine
description: An ergot-derived dopamine agonist approved for hyperprolactinaemia, acromegaly and Parkinson disease, and separately as Cycloset, a quick-release morning formulation, for type 2 diabetes.

systems.note: Dopaminergic suppression of prolactin and growth hormone secretion; the labelled indication.
The Cycloset presentation is labelled for glycaemic control in type 2 diabetes.
Ergot-derived valvulopathy and orthostatic hypotension are labelled.
Hepatically metabolised; transaminase elevation is reported.

monitors.why: The direct index of the pituitary effect.
Growth hormone suppression is a labelled acromegaly indication.
Glycaemic control is the labelled Cycloset indication.
